defs.def: a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family 王朝；朝代
a period of years during which members of a particular family rule a country 朝；代

ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.
ex.t: 宫保鸡丁（又名Kung Pao Chicken）原本是丁宝桢（又名丁宫保）的家常菜，他是清朝的一位高级官员，曾帮助重建四川成都的都江堰水利工程。

ex.s: Starting in the Yuan Dynasty, work on the terraces took hundreds of years, until its completion in the early Qing Dynasty.
ex.t: 梯田的修建始于元代，历经数百年，直到清初才完工。

ex.s: In China during the Shang Dynasty, people recorded weather forecasts on animal bones and tortoise shells.
ex.t: 中国商朝时期，人们把天气预报刻写在兽骨和龟甲上。

chunks.cn: 在 … 期间 该 王朝
